items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps skin clean without stripping it.
Hyaluronic acid adds a hydrated, plumper look, which helps skin look less dull.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a smooth, comfortable skin barrier and moisture that suits oilier skin.
Mineral zinc oxide SPF 50 protects daily and helps keep skin looking even and bright.

response.routine_note: I've left out the 30% peel because strong peels with salicylic acid aren't a good fit during pregnancy, so please check any exfoliating or peel products with your doctor or a dermatologist first. Use the cleanser, serum and moisturizer morning and night, and apply the SPF last each morning.
